name: openvino-coding-assistant
description: Set up a local coding assistant in VS Code Continue on Windows, using the OpenVINO Model Server (OVMS) model already on port 8000. Accept OpenVINO/Muse-Glimmer-30B-int4-ov or OpenVINO/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-int4-ov. Do not replace a running Muse-Glimmer or Qwen3.6 server. Download Qwen3.6 only when neither model is advertised. Needs VS Code with the Continue extension and the Dev Kit OVMS scripts. Not for Cursor, Hermes, or OpenClaw provider setup (intel-agent-provider-config), and not for installing the Developer Kit (intel-devkit-install).
